_note: Destination mode: what do AI assistants recommend in one destination? Separate from the hotel-based config. Engines refer to engine_ids in engines.json (prices live there). All questions run in web_search mode only.

destination_analyzer._note: The analyzer of destination mode (the hotel mode keeps its own in engines.json). Sonnet 5.5 rejects the temperature parameter, so temperature is null = not sent. Price $2/$10 checked 2026-10-18. Token assumptions measured on Sonnet 5.5 with analyzer v4: average of 16 analyses of run bled-trial-01 (2026-10-18) = 3,436 input / 1,156 output tokens (about $0.018 per analysis). Haiku 4.5 with v3 had averaged 2,908 / 995.

price_status._note: How far each price in engines.json is verified. Update a line to 'verified' only after you checked the official pricing page. Token counts per call are always ASSUMPTIONS until measured (see cost_assumptions in engines.json).
